title: Daebak Show w/ Eric Nam
author: DIVE Studios
description: Daebak (대박), a Korean word and phrase to describe something spectacular. Cue ‘Daebak Show’ hosted by Eric Nam, a long-time veteran in the industry as both a K-pop artist and celebrity personality. Here we celebrate music and media’s greatest hits, the people behind them, and get a glimpse into the industry. Catch up with us every Monday! Connect with us on Instagram, Twitter, and Facebook @thedivestudios
